title: Story premise ENT072: The Umbrella Left Open
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (silent emotional stories). Hook: Someone still needs the shelter. Takeaway/theme: A small kindness can be shown without a speech.
description: A figure wants to hurry home after rain, but notices a shivering paper bird beneath a dripping bench. They leave their umbrella open as a shelter and walk away; the next morning a neat row of paper feathers marks the route to the returned umbrella.
